title: Qualify cloned jsoup tag behavior at the original public parser
description: Compare the two pinned jsoup 2423 builds on registered, newly customized, late and ordinary tags. Check the parent element and text after two parses on the same clone. Retain the first frozen public plan, cold, warm and empty-cache evidence, and the result of replacing the fixed artifact at exactly the same path.
expected: Both original claim receipts agree with clean runs or record the first concrete open dependency. Replacing the repaired parser reopens or refutes the change and preserves ordinary tags. All declared reports carry verified receipts.
